family_summary: Relative to the originals, AI-built pages generally soften and flatten decoration: square corners become small rounded ones (often pill-shaped buttons or tags), transitions, shadows and gradients are reduced or replaced by flat styling and thin borders, and thick, dotted, torn-edge or banded section dividers and header rules are dropped or cut to hairlines, while a few sites gain extras such as colored card left borders, bordered rounded sidebar panels or header backdrop blur, and one keeps its textured header but loses its dark caption and video panels.
